subject: Evaluation plan & go/no-go signals for Acme Health pilot
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation plan & go/no-go signals for Acme Health pilot

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the time today. I pulled together a concise evaluation plan and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align on success criteria, exit gates, and acceptance tests before we spin up the pilot. I've attached a one-page MAP and a draft acceptance-test checklist (MAP_AcceptanceTests_v2.pdf). Please review and tell us where to tighten or expand.

High-level timeline (proposal):
- Week 0 (Nov 10): Kickoff, access + credentials, data sample ingest
- Weeks 1–2: Integration, smoke tests, latency profiling
- Weeks 3–4: Quality evals vs. annotated prompts + business acceptance tests
- Week 5 (Dec 15): Go/no-go decision window (final acceptance)

Proposed success criteria (binary pass/fail plus metrics):
- Latency: 95th <= 350ms for 512-token inference in our dedicated pilot config
- Cost: avg token cost within agreed credit band (proposal attached)
- Quality: F1/precision on labelled evaluation set >= 0.78 (we've scoped a 500-prompt eval)
- Privacy: No PHI leakage on synthetic PHI probe set; verified via log sampling and sandboxed runs

Exit gates (must pass all to proceed to final acceptance):
1) Integration: SDKs + auth verified, sample app can call generation API
2) Reliability: 99% success rate on 1k sampled requests over 24h
3) Security: SOC2 evidence review complete OR temporary TPA agreement in place

Acceptance tests (examples):
- End-to-end: ingest sample record set, run 500 eval prompts, measure metrics above
- Negative test: PHI redaction probe (should redact/return safe response)
- Load test: 10 RPS sustained for 30 minutes with <1% error

Open asks for you:
- Confirm the latency/quality guardrails or propose targets
- Any additional compliance constraints (e.g., on-prem only, IP allowlist)
- Preferred date for kickoff (we tentatively suggested Nov 10)

If these look reasonable I'll update the MAP PDF and share a DocuSign envelope for the pilot credits/terms so procurement can sign off.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attach: MAP_AcceptanceTests_v2.pdf
Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/ACME/record/6784123

From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com, Sam Li <sam.li@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & go/no-go signals for Acme Health pilot

Connor,

Appreciate the clear plan — this is close to what our stakeholders need. A few items from our side before we sign the MAP: 

1) PHI handling: we need an explicit acceptance test that confirms no PHI persists outside the sandbox (retention check + KV cache audit). Can you add a step that shows token-level retention and log redaction reporting?

2) Latency SLA: our baseline target is 95th <= 300ms for 512 tokens in the pilot environment (we're sensitive to user-facing latency). If Redwood needs 350ms as a pilot target, please call that out as an internal objective, but flag that our acceptance gate expects 300ms.

3) On-prem possibility: security raised a flag about a potential on-prem deployment if the hosted pilot shows unacceptable risks. For now we'd prefer hosted VPC, but add an "on-prem fallback" line in the MAP and a rough delta in timeline/cost.

I'm attaching our completed security questionnaire so you can pre-check (Acme_Security_Questionnaire_2025.xlsx). Procurement (Sam) will coordinate the terms.

Proposed kickoff: Nov 12 would work on our side (gives us a week to finalize the questionnaire and access). Can you confirm by EOD Friday?

Thanks,
Emily Turner
Director of Product, Acme Health
Attach: Acme_Security_Questionnaire_2025.xlsx

- We can offer a two-week hosted pilot at no charge up to a credit cap; if you move to on-prem we'd convert to a time-and-materials engagement with an estimated setup fee (TBD after Diego's scoping).
- To keep procurement moving, I'll share a short DocuSign for the pilot terms (proposal attached: Proposal_Credit_Tiers.pdf). Signing that will unlock access and the credit band.

Emily — if Nov 12 works for kickoff I'll mark resources and send the DocuSign.

All — thanks for the alignment. Procurement reviewed the pilot terms and confirmed we can sign the DocuSign this morning. Two confirmations from our side before kickoff: 

1) Acceptance tests: we want the final acceptance checklist in the MAP to include: 
   - PHI retention audit (no persisted PHI outside sandbox, evidence via log snapshot)
   - Functional quality: 500-prompt eval with Precision >= 0.78
   - Latency: 95th <= 300ms for 512 tokens in pilot config
   - Error/availability: <1% errors over baseline load test

2) Kickoff date: Confirming Nov 12 for the kickoff session and access handoff. 

Connor/Marissa: please send the updated MAP (with the explicit acceptance-test steps and the DocuSign link) and we'll countersign. Looking forward to working with Redwood on this pilot.

Sam Li
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Health
